# Who do your best customers have in common, and who else looks like them?

> A free, open-source alternative to lead-scoring add-ons: learn your ideal customer profile from your own won and lost list, rank your prospects by lookalike fit with a leave-one-out accuracy check, and draft compliant first outreach on your own AI key. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
